verdict.rationale: The official pricing docs publish 'Prices per 1M tokens' in a per-model standard table (input, cached input, cache writes, output), with batch and fine-tuning sections and no sales contact required. The models-compare page lists token pricing across the current catalog, and the batch (50% lower) and prompt-caching (up to 90% off) discounts are documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that every current model, including image and voice models, appears with public per-token prices.
